rt.consensus: By Any Means turns a compelling true story of racial injustice into an uneasy mix of exploitation thrills and prestige drama, with Yahya Abdul-Mateen II's nuanced performance too often overwhelmed by Mark Wahlberg's hammy antics.

verdict.ar: بأي وسيلة يحكي قصة عميل FBI أسود يتعاون مع القاتل المأجور غريغ سكاربا للتحقيق في مقتل قادة الحقوق المدنية بميسيسيبي سنة 1966. تقييم النقاد طلع مختلط، أداء Yahya Abdul-Mateen II قوي بس Mark Wahlberg يطغى عليه.
verdict.en: By Any Means follows a Black FBI agent teaming with mob hitman Greg Scarpa to investigate the murders of civil rights leaders in Mississippi in 1966. Critics are mixed, praising Yahya Abdul-Mateen II's performance but noting Mark Wahlberg overshadows it.

rt.consensus: If Out of the Further's modest efforts to put a fresh spin on Insidious only serve to underline how formulaic this franchise has become, some chilling set pieces distinguish it as one of the most effective entries yet.

verdict.ar: غدار: الخروج من العالم الآخر ياب 57% بس من 136 نقد. النقاد يقولون السلسلة صارت مكررة، بس فيه مشاهد رعب فعالة تميزه.
verdict.en: Insidious: Out of the Further scored 57% from 136 critics. Critics call the franchise formulaic, but praise some genuinely chilling set pieces.

rt.consensus: Interstellar represents more of the thrilling, thought-provoking, and visually resplendent filmmaking moviegoers have come to expect from writer-director Christopher Nolan, even if its intellectual reach somewhat exceeds its grasp.

verdict.ar: بين النجوم يوخذك مع رواد فضاء يدورون بيت يديد للبشرية بعد ما الأرض تعبت من الجوع والدمار. نقاد Rotten Tomatoes عطوه 73%، بس الجمهور حبّه بـ87%.
verdict.en: Interstellar follows astronauts searching for a new home for humanity after Earth is ravaged by famine. Critics gave it 73% on Rotten Tomatoes, while audiences loved it at 87%.

verdict.en: Critics gave it 35% but audiences scored it A-. Budget was $250M with only a $43M US opening—fine for kids, not for critics.

verdict.ar: نقاد Rotten Tomatoes عطوه 49% بس الجمهور عند 86%، يعني أكشن حلو بس حبكة معقدة وجو ثقيل. لو من محبين Statham بيعجبك، وإلا الفيلم مب مقنع للكل.
verdict.en: Critics gave it 49% on RT while audiences rated it 86%, so it's solid action weighed down by a convoluted, grim plot. Fine for Statham fans, less so for everyone else.

rt.consensus: Directed with pristine precision by Park Chan-wook, No Other Choice is a wickedly clever takedown of the corporate rat race that finds a perfect avatar in Lee Byung-Hun's skillfully hapless performance.

verdict.ar: Park Chan-wook يسوي كوميديا سوداء لاذعة عن سباق الشركات، والنقاد شبه مجمعين عليه بـ97%. Lee Byung-hun يقدّم أداء قوي وسط قصة ذكية ومتقنة.
verdict.en: Park Chan-wook delivers a wickedly sharp corporate black comedy that critics have rallied behind at 97%. Lee Byung-hun anchors it with a skillfully hapless performance.

rt.consensus: A colorful prehistoric adventure packed with lively action and engaging problem solving, PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie delivers exactly what its youngest fans want.

verdict.ar: باو باترول: The Dino Movie مغامرة حماسية بجزيرة ديناصورات، فيها أكشن وحل ألغاز يعجب العيال الصغار. النقاد عطوه 83% والجمهور 95%.
verdict.en: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie is a lively prehistoric adventure with engaging action and problem-solving that appeals to young viewers. Critics gave it 83% and audiences 95%.

rt.consensus: Nostalgic and inert, Practical Magic 2 has charms thanks to Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman's sisterly rapport, but its mechanical plotting is a whole lot of toil that's not worth the trouble.

verdict.ar: النقاد عطوه بس 36% من 163 نقد، بينما الجمهور حبه بنسبة 91%. لو تحب الفيلم الأول بترتاح له أكثر من النقاد.
verdict.en: Critics gave it just 36% from 163 reviews, while audiences loved it at 91%. Fans of the original will enjoy it more than critics did.

verdict.en: Pressure covers the 72 hours before D-Day, riding on a critical weather forecast. RT 87%, with Andrew Scott's performance and mounting tension praised.

rt.consensus: Spinning a web of spectacular set pieces together with mature emotional stakes and Tom Holland's soulful performance, Brand New Day is a promising reset that portends Spidey will remain sticky on the big screen for years to come.

verdict.ar: سبايدرمان يستاهل السينما، النقاد عطوه 90% والجمهور فوّق عليه بـ97%. قصة يديدة فيها أكشن وعواطف حقيقية مع توم هولاند.
verdict.en: Brand New Day is worth catching in theaters, critics gave it 90% and audiences loved it even more at 97%. A fresh story packed with real action and emotion led by Tom Holland.

rt.consensus: Dark, complex, and unforgettable, The Dark Knight succeeds not just as an entertaining comic book film, but as a richly thrilling crime saga.

verdict.ar: فارس الظلام من إخراج Christopher Nolan يحصد 94% من النقاد. قصة يديدة عن Batman والجوكر تستاهل المشاهدة.
verdict.en: The Dark Knight from director Christopher Nolan scores 94% with critics. A gripping Batman vs Joker story worth watching.

rt.consensus: The Dark Knight Rises is an ambitious, thoughtful, and potent action film that concludes Christopher Nolan's franchise in spectacular fashion.

verdict.ar: خاتمة ثلاثية Christopher Nolan إيت قوية، 87% من النقاد و90% من الجمهور معاها. Christian Bale وTom Hardy يقدّمون أكشن ودراما بمستوى وايد عالي.
verdict.en: The Dark Knight Rises closes Nolan's trilogy with critical acclaim, 87% from critics and 90% from audiences. Bale and Hardy deliver a potent, ambitious action finale.

rt.consensus: Tapping into the primal pleasures of the classic creature feature, The End of Oak Street is pulpy good fun carried off with a light touch and a sharp bite.

verdict.ar: 86% من النقاد يمدحونه، وشرات أفلام الوحوش الكلاسيكية بس بلمسة خفيفة وقصة قوية. عائلة كاملة تنتقل من 1982 لعصر الديناصورات، والجمهور معجب فيه 76%.
verdict.en: Critics love it at 86%, praising its pulpy creature-feature fun with a sharp bite. A suburban family is transported from 1982 into the age of dinosaurs, and audiences rate it 76%.

verdict.ar: الأوديسة من كريستوفر نولان ملحمة ضخمة بأداء جماعي قوي والنقاد شبه مجمعين عليها. تستاهل المشاهدة وخاصة بصيغة IMAX.
verdict.en: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey is a majestic epic with a colossal ensemble, and critics are nearly unanimous in their praise. Well worth watching, ideally in IMAX.

verdict.en: Originally Telugu, dubbed in Tamil, starring Nani and Mohan Babu. India TV rated it 2/5, with audiences praising Nani's performance but criticizing a weak second half and length.
